title: Android and Jetpack Compose
description: Conventions for Android and Jetpack Compose.

rules.title: Compose for new UI
rules.text: Build new UI in Jetpack Compose with stateless composables and state hoisting.

rules.title: ViewModel owns state
rules.text: Keep UI state in a ViewModel exposed as StateFlow and avoid business logic in composables.

rules.title: Request minimal permissions
rules.text: Request permissions at the moment of use and handle denial gracefully.

rules.title: Compose previews
rules.text: Add @Preview functions for composables with realistic sample data.
